case_name: Concurrency: Goroutine Leak on Context Cancellation

subject_result.rationale: The review perfectly met all rubric requirements. It clearly identified the goroutine leak caused by the unbuffered channel when ctx.Done() fires, explaining the exact mechanism and impact. It explicitly recommended buffering the channel with `make(chan fetchResult, 1)` and suggested propagating the context down to the backend fetcher.
findings: Accurately identified the critical goroutine leak on context cancellation due to sending to an unbuffered channel with no receiver.
Correctly recommended using a buffered channel (`make(chan fetchResult, 1)`).
Suggested context propagation to the backend call as well as fast-failing if context is already canceled.
No false positives; the feedback is clear, constructive, and highly relevant.
